name: fj-income-tax
description: Use this Fiji income tax reference for self-employed individuals, sole traders and wage earners: resident and non-resident rates, chargeable income, allowable deductions, advance tax, provisional tax, FNPF contribution, PAYE and the PIT return. Match requests such as "how much tax do I pay in Fiji", "FRCS income tax return", "PIT return", "Personal Income Tax Return for Business Individual", "self-employed tax Fiji", "provisional tax", "SRT", "Social Responsibility Tax", "ECAL", "FNPF contribution", "chargeable income", "tax-free threshold", "allowable deductions" and "VAT registration Fiji". Bands rest on Legal Notice 55 of 2023. No 2026 Act was read, so the 2026-27 Budget measures are shown as held. This Tier 2 draft supports source checking and reviewer questions; it does not authorise filing, payment or a tax position.
